newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin ends down on London's fall.
newsitem.headline: KL tin ends down on London's fall.

text.p: Tin price ended five cents lower at 15.13 ringgit ($6.08) a kg as the market took its cue from a lower London market overnight, traders said.
"The market was easier. Falls were mainly due to the lower London market yesterday," a dealer said, adding that buying was also much reduced.
Turnover dropped to 108 tonnes from 156 on Thursday with buying mainly from Europe and Malaysia.
The local price differential over London was at $10 a tonne premium after holding at par on Thursday.
